item.title: Taveuni shock Nadroga 32-22 in Skipper Cup
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 22/08/2026 Taveuni Rugby have caused a major upset, defeating Nadroga 32-22 in Round 4 of the Skipper Cup Competition.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 22/08/2026

Taveuni Rugby have caused a major upset, defeating Nadroga 32-22 in Round 4 of the Skipper Cup Competition.

This is Taveuni’s second win of the season, following their 27-25 victory over Ba last weekend.

In other results, Malolo beat Kadavu 18-14, Ba defeated Navosa 26-21, Lautoka beat Rewa 28-23, Naitasiri defeated Suva 29-26 and Tailevu drew 19-all with Nadi.
